LEAF 8ce5 — PUSHED FOR REVIEW (phase 4g).

Gerrit change 2503: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2503
Commit 489088bbe2f6 (after msg amend), 5 files / 1857 insertions:
  scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py (new, 557 lines)
  tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json (new, 917 lines, 6 declared divergences)
  tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py (new, 348 lines, 23 tests)
  Makefile (lint wiring after gen_env_registry --check, house @# block)
  docs/generated-artifacts.md (new 'Gate-internal manifests' section)

TWO PUSH-MECHANICS LESSONS WORTH KEEPING:
 1. The commit-msg hook enforces 50/72 wrapping and REJECTED the first message. Gerrit renders the
    description as preformatted text, so the wrap is a real reviewer-facing constraint, not style.
 2. Gerrit then rejected the push with 'not Signed-off-by author/committer/uploader in message
    footer' — because appending the Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers after a BLANK LINE split
    the footer block, so Gerrit no longer saw Signed-off-by inside it. Fix: ALL trailers must be one
    CONTIGUOUS block (rebar-ticket, Signed-off-by, Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session, Change-Id).
    Both amends used 'make amend-msg' per AGENTS.md, so Change-Id I653256d5... was carried forward
    and the push created ONE change (2503), not a duplicate.

CLAIM STATE: f9b9 re-review PASSED -> sign-review -> certified. Claimed now: epic 87cb, 8ce5, 0880,
15f2, b0ac, and f9b9 in flight. Only 9ca8 (unblacked-loveless-toad) still ungated — it had the four
substantive design findings, so its re-review is the one most likely to need a second remediation
pass.

NEXT: yogic-soapstone-takin (f9b9) — the mirror-inventory report. It goes SECOND in the stack
(above 8ce5) and carries the .gitignore '/reports/*' + '!/reports/stability/' change that
floaty-imperfect-pomeranian will inherit. Evidence base is the completed sweep: 77 candidates
examined, 14 genuine mirrors, 5 already drifted.
